title: GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Kit: Reverse Transcription
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the second part of a ten part protocol for the [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Kit](https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/instruments-and-automation/genereader-system/generead-qiaact-lung-panels-ww/?catno=181936) which constructs molecularly bar-coded DNA libraries for digital sequencing. This protocol automates the Reverse transcription part described in the [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Handbook](https://www.qiagen.com/us/resources/download.aspx?id=1a71d98a-c45c-44fa-b4af-874cd1d2b61f&lang=en). * Part 1: [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210) * Part 2: [Reverse transcription](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-2) * Part 3: [Second strand synthesis](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-3) * Part 4: [End repair / dA tailing](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-4) * Part 5: [Adaptor ligation](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-5) * Part 6: [Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-6) * Part 7: [Target Enrichment PCR](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-7) * Part 8: [Cleanup of Target Enrichment PCR with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-8) * Part 9: [Universal PCR Amplification](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-9) * Part 10: [Cleanup of Universal PCR with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-10) Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: The total number of DNA samples. Samples must range between 1 (minimum) and 12 (maximum). * `P20 Single GEN2 Pipette Mount Position`: The position of the pipette, either left or right. ---

steps.title: Preheat thermocycler lid
steps.instruction: Set the thermocycler lid temperature to 103 °C and allow it to pre‑heat.

steps.title: Cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Cool the temperature module down to 4 °C.

steps.title: Add RT reagents to RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer BC3 Buffer, RNase Inhibitor, and EZ Reverse Transcriptase into each primed RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: Transfer BC3 Buffer to primed RNA samples
Add RNase Inhibitor to primed RNA samples
Add EZ Reverse Transcriptase to primed RNA samples

steps.title: Mix reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Pipette 4 µL of the mixture and mix by pipetting up and down 7 times.

steps.title: Brief centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples briefly to collect liquid at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Run reverse transcription program
steps.instruction: Place the PCR plate in the thermocycler and run the following program: 25 °C for 10 min, 42 °C for 30 min, 70 °C for 15 min, then hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Final centrifugation and ice
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples briefly once more and then place them on ice.
